stations.title: Marit
stations.say: Can the board use Hollis's list?

captions: At Gritstone Climbing, Marit wants the route board to follow the real list.
The board was typed by hand, so it still shows Sloper Season, long gone.
You write the code that draws the board from the list, in three tasks.
Now the board shows what is on the walls, and Sloper Season is off it.
Change the list and the board follows. They can never disagree again.
